cases.label: Slope 0 with intercept 1
cases.rationale: The root is mathematically undefined (no crossing); it must be reported as undefined, not as zero.

cases.label: Slope 0 with intercept 0
cases.rationale: Every x is a root; no single value exists.

cases.label: m·p + b = 10 exactly
cases.rationale: The coupled constraint is inclusive at 10.

cases.label: m·p + b = 10.5
cases.rationale: Just past the inclusive bound: rejected before evaluation.
